source.edition: Dungeon Masters Guide, 1st edition / revised December 1979 source scan as recorded in existing matrix review; no broader printing claim.

method.approach: Source-first DMG inventory independent of the website catalog. Read repository citation rules; inspect actual private source pixels with PyMuPDF and view_image before recording source assertions. Reconcile only bounded source units against the assembled distribution and app behavior.

outlineEndpointRenders.scope: Every distinct printed start/end page candidate for the 51 contents/index outline units was rendered from the actual PDF and viewed individually. The 2.4x renders of PDF173–176 were also viewed individually for the Appendix A/B/C boundary; the separate printed-p.175 JPEG was viewed individually. This checks outline candidates and visible overlaps, not all source units on these pages.

method.pixelReviewScope: Visual screening means page-image screening only. The contact-sheet pages are not semantically checked; no inference of completeness follows. p74 review is limited to table headers/row/column counts and printed notes; no 378-cell transcription is included.
method.sourceIndexUse: Visually read the contents and Tables and Charts index; index labels are stored as locator candidates only. PyMuPDF text/OCR was used for candidate discovery, not as a source-content pass.

denominatorPolicy.warning: A finite contents/index inventory is not the semantic source-unit denominator. Inline procedures, definitions, qualifiers, footnotes, page/column continuations, and unindexed tables remain unenumerated.

method.privateStorage: Full PDFs, page renders, contact sheets, and dmg175.jpg remain under /workspace/vault-audit-private; only this JSON and already-authorized limited excerpts are in the repository.

separateSupplementalEndpoint.visualReview: individually viewed; separate from canonical PDF
